name: Gift Card Page
summary: Gift-card presentation with target-formatted card content, copy and action hooks, optional QR media, and a workflow-neutral canonical form-composition region.

anatomy.name: codeWrapper
anatomy.description: Gift-card code and optional copy-action wrapper.

anatomy.name: balance
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted balance content; this contract does not calculate it.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Sizing hook composed with canonical Input anatomy; Input owns label, message, and validation state.

states.name: copyFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the copy action.

states.name: primaryAction
states.description: Primary action styling hook; it does not define the action's workflow.

states.name: secondaryAction
states.description: Secondary action styling hook; it does not define the action's workflow.

states.name: actionFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on target-owned actions.

behavior.name: copyCode
behavior.description: When supplied, the target-owned copy action copies the visible code and announces success or failure without making visual change the only feedback.

behavior.name: commerceContentBoundary
behavior.description: Targets supply formatted amounts, optional balance content, actions, and QR payloads. This contract does not calculate balance or define redemption, purchase, or account workflows.

behavior.name: formComposition
behavior.description: If a target supplies a value-entry form, it composes canonical Input and Button anatomy. Fields preserve default, error, success, warning, hover, focus-visible, disabled, label, message, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby obligations; the form's purpose and endpoint remain target-owned.

properties.name: visual
properties.description: Gift-card visual media and optional readable overlay content.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Target-formatted gift-card amount; no numeric calculation is inferred.

properties.name: copyLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for an optional icon-only copy button.

properties.name: balance
properties.description: Optional target-formatted balance content; this property does not define how balance is obtained or refreshed.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Target-owned actions without a contract-defined purchase or redemption workflow.

properties.name: qr
properties.description: Optional target-supplied QR media and accessible purpose text.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Optional target-owned native form composed from canonical Input and Button anatomy without assigning a workflow.

accessibility: Keep the gift-card code selectable and expose a clearly named native copy button when copying is supported.
Announce copy success or failure without relying on icon or color change alone.
Provide useful alternative text for meaningful gift-card imagery and explain the purpose of QR media.
Treat amount and balance strings as target-formatted content with clear currency context.
Any composed value-entry field uses canonical Input label, message, default, error, success, and warning semantics; aria-invalid is reserved for error.
Target-owned actions retain native element semantics, visible focus, and understandable accessible names.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/pages.css; commerce workflows remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: Gift-card data and available actions require target-native mapping without this contract assuming balance, redemption, or purchase behavior.
